title: Oracle-blind review of Compose rehearsal isolation
rationale: The rehearsal profile explicitly enables a Grafana Cloud exporter, which violates the zero-remote-write rehearsal boundary, and the base Compose file replaces a required immutable image with an implicit latest fallback. Required security/export-negative automation and isolated rehearsal/rollback evidence are not present.
scope_architecture: Local configuration and rehearsal observability are in scope, but both changed defaults violate operational invariants. SP-FAIL-001 applies to the image fallback, and SP-FAIL-003 applies because the rehearsal profile actively enables external export instead of proving remote writes are zero.

findings.finding: The rehearsal profile adds and explicitly enables the Grafana Cloud exporter.
findings.evidence: The new service is in the rehearsal profile and sets GRAFANA_CLOUD_EXPORT_ENABLED to true.
findings.impact: An isolated rehearsal can send duplicate or private metrics to an external service, crossing the production/export boundary.
findings.required_change: Remove the external exporter from every rehearsal profile and enforce zero remote-write configuration in the rendered rehearsal topology.
findings.suggested_test: Render the exact rehearsal Compose project and verify the exporter is absent, credentials are isolated, ports are loopback-only, mounts are isolated, and remote writes are zero.

findings.finding: APP_IMAGE no longer fails when missing and instead falls back to an implicit latest image.
findings.evidence: The required-variable interpolation is replaced with a default of latest.
findings.impact: Local, CI, rehearsal, or release operations can pull or run an unintended mutable image, fail unexpectedly, or rehearse an artifact different from the candidate.
findings.required_change: Restore fail-fast APP_IMAGE interpolation and require a non-secret immutable candidate tag or digest in every rendered topology.
findings.suggested_test: Test that missing or empty APP_IMAGE fails clearly and that the exact supplied candidate image is present in rendered local and rehearsal configuration.

findings.finding: The reported Compose/CI pass does not provide the required security checks or a negative assertion that rehearsal export is absent.
findings.evidence: The supplied automated evidence names only Compose config and CI despite the security_secrets flag and the explicit exporter change.
findings.impact: Configuration can render successfully while still exposing credentials or sending remote data, so the reported PASS is a false assurance for the selected risks.
findings.required_change: Run and report the security, dependency-audit, secret-safe configuration, and exporter-absence checks with exact commands and results.
findings.suggested_test: Run nox -s security deps_audit and a rendered-config assertion that rejects cloud-export services, remote-write endpoints, and non-isolated credentials in rehearsal.

findings.finding: The required isolated rehearsal, export inspection, and rollback evidence was not run.
findings.evidence: The supplied manual evidence explicitly records the rehearsal/export inspection as NOT RUN.
findings.evidence_excerpt: manual NOT RUN isolated rehearsal/export inspection
findings.impact: Rendered configuration alone cannot prove startup, health, recovery, zero remote writes, or a safe rollback boundary for an availability-sensitive topology change.
findings.required_change: Complete an isolated candidate rehearsal with startup, health, zero-export inspection, failure recovery, rollback, and post-rollback health evidence.
findings.suggested_test: manual: Have the authorized operator rehearse the immutable candidate in a distinct loopback-only project, verify zero remote writes, inject a failure, roll back only application services, and record health results.

contract_consumer_review: APP_IMAGE is a required deployment contract and must fail clearly rather than silently selecting latest. The rehearsal profile is also a security/privacy boundary whose consumers include the external exporter; enabling it is not local observability. The patches provide no safe compatibility or rollout path for either default change.

evidence_matrix.check: Security/dependency audit and automated exporter-absence assertion
Isolated candidate rehearsal, zero-export inspection, failure recovery, and rollback

operations_safety_security_privacy: The patch can activate external export during rehearsal and can run an unintended image when APP_IMAGE is absent. This violates isolation, secret/privacy, immutable-candidate, and availability rules. No Compose stack was started and no external service was contacted during review.
documentation_assessment: No reviewed documentation explains or safely authorizes the changed image default, rehearsal exporter, credential boundary, zero-remote-write proof, or rollback. The changes conflict with the stable rehearsal rules rather than documenting a valid operational design.
limitations: Review was limited to the supplied hash-verified Compose patch, mandatory stable rules, reviewer guidance, schema, and direct evidence packet.
No Docker stack, network endpoint, credential, production host, or unlisted evaluation artifact was accessed.
The reported PASS did not include rendered output, security logs, exporter-negative assertions, or rehearsal artifacts.
